args: In this fresh isolated workspace, fix inclusiveRange in inclusive-range.mjs so integer start/end values produce every integer from start through end inclusive, while descending ranges return an empty array. Read inclusive-range.mjs and inclusive-range.test.mjs, change only inclusive-range.mjs using the file edit tool, and keep inclusive-range.test.mjs byte-for-byte unchanged. Do not delegate this small task. Then use the registered powershell process profile to run node --test inclusive-range.test.mjs from the workspace root. Inspect the actual exit code and test counts before reporting success. Install nothing, start no services, and change no other files.
